name: Houzz Pro API v1
description:
The Houzz Pro API gives verified partners programmatic access to the data and workflows that pros use every day — projects, leads, contacts, tasks, scheduling, files, and more.

All endpoints require OAuth 2.0 authentication using the client credentials flow. Include a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header on every request. Tokens are issued per scope; the required scope is listed under the **Authorization** section of each operation.

**Base URL:** `https://pro-api.houzz.com/api`

**Versioning:** All endpoints are prefixed with `/v1`. Breaking changes will be introduced under a new version prefix.

**Pagination:** List endpoints accept `limit` (max 300, default 20) and `offset` query parameters and return `{ data, limit, offset, total }`.

**Errors:** All errors return `{ error: { code, message } }` with a standard HTTP status code.
